{{Top|leg}}
An '''Energy Coupler''' was part of a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser's]] inner firing mechanism. Energy from the [[Power core/Legends|power core]] was collected in the Energy Coupler before being released into the [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuators]] to fire.<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref>
